brief:
Palestinians displaced from Tulkarem refugee camp in the West Bank are hoping to return home following Israeli military operations in the area, Al Jazeera English reported. The raids have forced families from their residences, leaving them unable to access their belongings and livelihoods.

The displaced residents express determination to rebuild their lives and restore normalcy to the camp, though the timeline for their return remains uncertain amid the ongoing security situation in the West Bank.
dek: Palestinians have been displaced from their homes in Tulkarem refugee camp and dream of returning home.
title: Palestinians displaced from Tulkarem camp dream of return after Israeli raids
